author: Khan Academy
description:
Science seeks to explain the natural world. Engineering applies scientific knowledge to solve problems. Technology includes objects, processes, and systems that result from engineering. Everyday examples illustrate how engineers use a systematic approach to design, test, and improve solutions that solve problems.

Sections:
00:00 - How did we build all of this?
00:40 - Science, technology, and engineering
01:18 - What is technology?
01:46 - From rocks to computer chips
03:14 - Engineering: the bridge between science and technology
04:38 - How engineers apply science
05:34 - Summary
